extended_representation.representation: acyclic definitional OR-chain CNF with fresh existential auxiliary variables

scientific_update: R14's minimum same-variable CNF width 6 is representation-specific. Once fresh existential extension variables are allowed, the already-known exact W05 interface has a width<=3 representation with linear definitional overhead.
hard_wall: R15A begins from the already-exposed exact semantic interface. It does not show how to discover the 242 constraints or the 100 useful extension variables directly from the GENERAL_CNF frame without exact-shadow information. Representation existence and representation compilation are different problems.
next_gate: R15B_DIRECT_FROM_FRAME_EXTENSION_COMPILER: freeze an extension-variable compiler before new unseen worlds; no exact interface, truth table, or post-hoc missing-prime information may influence atom introduction or routing.
claim_ceiling: No SAT-in-P claim, no polynomial direct-from-frame compiler claim, and no P=NP/P!=NP conclusion.
